path.reason.physical-risk: There is a physical or clinical risk (for example, rehabilitating an injury).
path.reason.no-signal: No signal from the camera or the microphone measures it.
path.reason.unsupported-object: It needs an object that VYRO cannot detect yet.

settings.microphone.note: It only turns on while you practise a skill with sound. The audio is never saved and never leaves your computer: it is analysed at once and only numbers are kept.
